_comment: GEMMA4 NATIVE-ACTUATION frozen spec (2026-09-23): the RPBE recursion node is the native CCM merge step (M_{t-1}, u_t) -> M_t with depth D=L and Z_t = M_t; actuated params = conditional LoRA (q/k/v/o r=8; gemma shared layers 24-41 have no k/v_proj so they carry q/o only) + COMP/SUM comp-embedding rows (SeparatedEmbedding layout, train_ccm_merge chain — build_model aligns to it). The backbone (Step-1 foundation merge + base) is frozen; NO Gamma module. Native-Ours runs the treewise feasibility projection in ADAMW PROPOSAL space (same frozen geometry as the qwen3 native line). Theta_0 = Step-1 foundation merged base + init-from the gemma Stage-2 merge checkpoint step600 (user ruling 2026-09-23: fork from step600).
frozen_source: Qwen3 native-actuation frozen spec (frozen_method_qwen3_native.json, review 2026-09-22) re-instantiated on the gemma4 host; gemma merge protocol per frozen_method_gemma4.json / CCM_Gemma4_Porting_Spec.md

actuation.scope: conditional LoRA q/k/v/o r=8 (shared layers q/o only — a gemma architecture fact) + COMP/SUM comp_embeddings rows (SeparatedEmbedding); recursion node = native merge step (M_{t-1}, u_t) -> M_t, depth D=L; Z_t = M_t via JMemLift unchanged
actuation.theta0: frozen Gemma-4-E4B base + Step-1 default-LoRA foundation merge (train_ccm_merge build chain) + init-from Stage-2 merge checkpoint_step600.pt (LoRA + COMP rows loaded; no Gamma exists)
actuation.projection_space: AdamW proposal space (same as qwen3 native line): d_0 = shadow-AdamW joint proposal from g_task + lambda*g_pred; d* = argmin 1/2||d-d_0||^2 s.t. q_i^T d >= -kappa*||q_i||*||d_task||; theta <- theta + d* written back directly
actuation.lambda_fact: lambda does NOT affect the pure half-space feasibility region (cancels on both sides); lambda is meaningful only through the joint proposal center d_0

backbone.model: Gemma-4-E4B base (text-only decoder from the released multimodal ckpt)
backbone.kv_sharing: layers 24-41 share k/v proj — LoRA targets q/o there; SUM merge/Γ/mem_callback live on non-shared layers only (ccm_gemma4.py)

adapter.lora_r_note: r=8 conditional LoRA q/k/v/o (shared layers q/o) + COMP/SUM rows — the ONLY trainable params under native actuation. lora_dropout pinned 0.0 for the two-pass replay identity.

lambda_calibration.rule: same as the qwen3 native line: r_eff = lambda * ||d_pred|| / ||d_task|| ~ 0.1 measured at theta_0 (init-from step600) on the first closed window, native proposal-space (lr=1 direction space), then frozen.
lambda_calibration.lambda_kf_note: Calibrated 2026-09-23 (gemma native proposal-space r_eff at theta_0 = init-from step600): r_eff = 1.0013, derived lambda = 0.1/1.0013 = 0.0999.  Matches the qwen3 native value (0.0998, r_eff 1.002) — the proposal-space r_eff on native compression params is ~1 across hosts.

rpbe.z_v_source: J_mem(M_v) fixed adapter; GQA hosts lift the memory from the KV heads; native mode lifts the PURE CCM mean (no Gamma residual exists)
rpbe.sketch_ensemble_note: four independent 32-dim branches (J_ens = mean_r J_r); depth bucket b(L_v) modulates the future signature phi_r.

oas_shrinkage.rule: paired OAS covariance shrinkage per branch; the fixed ridge keeps only its numerical-safety role.

gamma.placement: NOT ATTACHED in native mode (kept for the enforce_frozen gamma.hidden binding)

window.collection: adaptive by effective cut count (dialogues with k>=4), not a mechanical microbatch count
window.cadence: identical task samples and scheduler cadence across the two native arms

training.steps_note: EXTENDED to 20 windows (user ruling 2026-09-24): the first 10 follow the 2026-09-23 fork ruling (step600 fork, treewise, checkpoint every 2); the s10->s20 continuation resumes from checkpoint_step10 (full state: optimizer/scheduler/rng) with --no-warmup on the same treewise protocol — the s6/s8 PPL curve kept improving (deep buckets recovering), so the user ruled to keep treewise running.  trainable = conditional LoRA + COMP rows (backbone frozen, NO Gamma).

official_protocol.data_stream: shuffled epoch loop (each dialogue exactly once per epoch)
official_protocol.micro_batch_note: RPBE arms require micro-batch 1 (two-pass replay protocol)

training.two_pass_replay: pass1 no-grad statistics forward, pass2 grad replay forward (RPBE arms only)

proposal_space.center: d_0 = shadow AdamW proposal of g_joint = g_task + lambda*g_pred (moments read from the CURRENT optimizer state, never stepped)
proposal_space.constraint_norm: ||d_task|| = shadow AdamW proposal norm of the PURE task gradient (snapshotted before the aux accumulation)
proposal_space.half_spaces: q_i^T d* >= -kappa*||q_i||*||d_task|| (lower bound in update space)
proposal_space.write_back: theta <- theta + d*; optimizer moments updated with the true-value clipped joint gradient; scheduler/scaler cadence identical to the task-only arm
proposal_space.cert_fail: whole-window skip including the task update (inherited gamma-line semantics), cert_skip_steps recorded

training.seeds_note: seed 0 only (same ruling as the qwen3 line)
training.eval: gemma Stage-2 ckpts evaluate via eval_ccm_depth.py --mode ccm --host gemma4 --foundation <step1> --ours-ckpt X --pooled (protocol B buckets; NLL output, PPL = exp(nll))
training.checkpoint_every_note: user ruling 2026-09-23: checkpoint every 2 windows (10-window budget -> s2..s10 + final)
training.schedule_note: warmup/cosine over 1000 steps (warmup ratio 0.03); --no-warmup on the fork: the first window steps at the peak lr and the cosine descends from there

sampling.q_alpha_note: q_L ∝ n_L^q_alpha, q_alpha=1 (natural frequency) with the replay cap — same convention as the qwen3 native line
sampling.rule: depth-stratified legal cuts with natural-frequency depth weights + per-dialogue replay cap; ONE original dialogue per window (tree_id = stable original dialogue id); L=1 dialogues carry task CE only.

freeze_host.scope: native mode freezes the BACKBONE only: trainable = conditional LoRA + COMP/SUM rows; the trainer refuses --freeze-host / --rpbe-gamma-only / --rpbe-lr under native actuation
freeze_host.mode: model.train() throughout (lora_dropout pinned 0.0 keeps the two-pass replay identity)
